name: Lion Office Products Corp.
summary: Lion Office Products Corp. manufactures and sells stationery, office furniture, products for welfare and nursing care, educational equipment and ICT-related goods. Its stationery range includes staplers, paper punches, scissors, rulers, clips, inks, files, cutting mats, numbering machines and tape dispensers. Kohachiro Fukui founded the company in 1792, and it has its headquarters in Higashiosaka-shi, Japan.
